What degraded

  • Shipped at the round cap at 7.418, 0.28 under the 7.7 rung and 0.58 under the 8.0 top rung. Frame 6, the declared turn, still reads as a cork with bead-like flies; three recompositions tripped the strike detector or read worse.

  • Scanner ceiling not checked (no D1 or Worker settings access).
  • tests/article_edition.mjs could not run locally (no node playwright package); CI runs it.

Named here rather than left out. A run that quietly ships less than it planned teaches nobody anything.

Post this

Upload the PDF to LinkedIn as a document, title it Software pointed at a gene. Flies ran the test., paste the post copy under it, then paste the first comment within a minute of posting.

carousel.pdf   contact sheet   the site

1. The post copy

Software did not diagnose this child.

The child was enrolled in the Texome Project. Standard analysis found no answer. Then AI-MARRVEL flagged a rare change in a gene called BRSK1.

That flag was a lead. Testing it took families and flies.

Through GeneMatcher the study grew to 10 affected people from seven unrelated families. In flies the gene is sff, for "sugar-free frosting." Switched off, the flies had trouble moving and lived shorter lives. The normal human gene largely corrected them. The three patient versions only partly did.

Every affected person had some developmental delay. Texas Children's calls the variants a likely diagnosis.

Texome takes candidates from underserved families with a suspected rare disease who can't pay. Testing is free and visits can be virtual. Could a family you know write to texome-project@bcm.edu?

#TexomeProject #TexasChildrens #BaylorMedicine

The machine changed itself

  • fly_vial and vial_tray lifted into assets/js/kit/interior.js at the judges' fix (a Drosophila that reads at macro, glass with rim and glints, food with a meniscus)

    The craft judge named a floating monitor on frame 3
  • fetch_doc.py asks the host's live robots.txt before fetching and on redirects
    It fetched two robots-disallowed urls during re-verification; copies deleted unread
  • ENGINE PROPOSALS FOR A MAINTAINER (txthree.js and qa.py are human lane): coping contact and grit in TXT.contact; real trees instead of scatter cards; silhouette-masked blur; a window option for TXT.interior; qa.py's strike detector false positives on heavy serif last lines and dark grounds
    The artwork defects the panel ranked that no run can reach. Details in knowledge/carousel/UPGRADE_BACKLOG.md under 2026-10-02

Notes

THE RECORD. 120 items were due. 99 were stamped and 21 carry a dated line naming what is unconfirmed behind a boundary. Three admitted: tx-2026-0195 (Texas Children's and Baylor name BRSK1 variants a likely diagnosis after the AI tool AI-MARRVEL flagged the gene), tx-2026-0196 (the Fifteenth Court of Appeals in CreateAI v. Bot Auto) and tx-2026-0197 (the NSF HBCU AI node at Texas Southern). The record holds 170. Corrections to tx-2026-0001, 0096 and 0107; added claims on 0071 and 0126. A ROBOTS BREACH, FOUND AND FIXED. fetch_doc.py fetched two robots-disallowed urls (a Hays County agenda on public.destinyhosted.com and a fox34.com story) during manual re-verification, because it asked only the crawl boundary registry. The copies were deleted unread and nothing from them was used. It now asks the host's live robots.txt before fetching and on every redirect. THE DECK. Carousel no. 40 shipped at the round cap after five panel rounds (medians 7.17, 7.23, 7.304, 7.41, 7.418) with no hard fail in any round. The integrity judge's round 1 findings were all repaired: Texome's eligibility on frame 9 and in the caption, a new claim c51 for all three patient variants giving only a partial rescue, "Baylor classifier" removed where no quote carried it, and frame 9's visit stickers no longer placed on months. The drag every round was the artwork: frame 6, the turn, reads as a cork with bead-like flies, and the vial is small in the four room frames. DID THIS RUN STOP AND WAIT FOR A HUMAN. Reading taken before the merge. prompt_audit.py exits 1: 1,621 tool calls measured, 478 with a permission decision over its threshold, the longest 5.3 seconds (a Bash call). No call waited longer than about five seconds and the run never stalled; these look like an automatic permission check rather than a person, which is not established. No-stall hook: armed at 06:15:30 UTC, judged the session unattended from the start with the host's CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ATTENDED=0, refused nothing. One cleanup command (a relative glob rm of scratch files after a cd) was refused by a built-in safety check and was not run or retried; the files are gitignored scratch.

This is a draft. Nothing was sent. The deck is already merged to main, so these links are live. Posting is the only step left, and it is yours.
